description: Gives every channel of a polyphonic signal its own level control, scaling each channel's voltage before passing it to the output

params.text: Sets the scale factor for that polyphonic channel, 0 to 1x by default and 1x when the module is initialised; knobs above the output channel count do nothing

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal to be scaled; its channel count sets the output channel count unless the menu fixes a count

outputs.text: The scaled polyphonic signal, one channel per level knob in use

notes: the display reads the output channel count, yellow when that count covers the input and red when it is fewer channels than the input carries
menu: Level range — the range shared by all sixteen knobs: 0-1x, 0-2x, 0-5x or 0-10x, or bipolar +/- 1x, +/- 2x, +/- 5x or +/- 10x, which allows inversion
Polyphony channels — Auto follows the input, or 1 to 16 fixes the output channel count; a monophonic input is cloned to fill it, and missing input channels count as 0V
